findings.source_quote: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind –2 Timothy 1:4-7.
findings.suggested_fix: This is a faithful rendering, but consider the alternative Spanish terms used in many Bibles for 2 Timothy 1:7. If you want closer alignment with common Spanish Bible phrasing, you might replace “dominio propio” with “sobriedad” or “sobriedad de juicio”. Preserve the rest of the verse and the citation exactly as rendered. Example: “Porque no nos ha dado Dios espíritu de cobardía, sino de poder, de amor y de sobriedad –2 Timoteo 1:7.”
findings.translation_quote: Porque no nos ha dado Dios espíritu de cobardía, sino de poder, de amor y de dominio propio –2 Timoteo 1:4-7.

findings.source_quote: ...if she would hang a scarlet thread from her window on the wall, her house and her life would be spared. A scarlet thread.
findings.suggested_fix: Translation is accurate and idiomatic. As a minor stylistic option, translators sometimes render “scarlet thread” as “hebra escarlata” or “cordel escarlata” depending on preferred register. No correction required; this is optional.
findings.translation_quote: Los hombres de Israel le dijeron que si colgaba un cordón escarlata desde su ventana en el muro, su casa y su vida serían preservadas. Un cordón escarlata.
